title: [MTR4] PKP IC Coaches (sncb eurofima coaches retexture)
description:
This pack adds the PKP Intercity coaches from poland,  which are just a simple retexture of the SNCB Eurofima coaches.

body:

!!! THE COACHES MAY SHOW UP AS SNCB, IM NOT SURE. !!!
